build_GridHead: build a GridHead module with 9 grid points and 8 conv layers for Grid R-CNN mask refinement
review_GridHead_init_weights: review the GridHead init_weights method that applies Kaiming and normal initialization to conv layers
run_GridHead_forward: run the GridHead forward pass to produce fused and unfused heatmap predictions from ROI features
test_GridHead_get_targets: test the GridHead get_targets method that computes grid point heatmap targets from sampling results
refactor_GridHead_get_bboxes: refactor the GridHead get_bboxes method that refines detection bboxes using weighted voting of grid point predictions
